item.title: A little Robin told me: A little grace for the Tiger
item.description: There is a difference between asking hard questions and delivering a public scolding. item.title: Fire consumes home in south DeLand
item.description: An intense fire in a neighborhood with closely situated apartments was successfully contained to one home by the DeLand Fire Department, a DFD spokesperson said. The fire occurred around 1 a.m. Feb. 3 on Water Willow Drive in the Clara Place Apartments in DeLand, south of New Hampshire Avenue and just west of Woodland Boulevard, spokesperson Sarah Lux said. item.title: Multiple cold fronts sweep across Florida
item.description: The past several days have brought a quite unseasonable and prolonged chill to the Sunshine State and the southeastern U.S. in general. The cold wave was such that places not accustomed to seeing snow were treated to measurable white precipitation, as frigid winds made the feel-like temperatures outdoors much worse than the mercury readings of thermometers indicated. item.title: Foundations to Freedom installs first Narcan vending machine in Pierson
